functionality.rationale: Destination decisions must reject, relocate, or explicitly rename without implicit overwrite or merge.

security.rationale: Peer input, links, normalization, and commit races must not redirect writes or replace existing objects.

performance.rationale: Collision checks over large manifests must remain bounded and avoid repeated full-tree traversal.

compatibility.rationale: Receiver-local policy must preserve manifest identities while respecting platform-native name behavior.

concurrency.rationale: Selection and commit are separated by time and require collision rechecks against concurrent filesystem changes.

platform.rationale: Reserved names, case folding, Unicode, links, permissions, and cross-device behavior differ by filesystem.

persistence.rationale: Policy mistakes could overwrite or merge durable receiver data.

adr.rationale: The task implements receiver-local storage policy already required by protocol v1.

architecture.rationale: Destination enforcement remains within the existing native storage boundary.

roadmap.rationale: XT-039 owns roadmap closure after public adapter and UI integration.
